about.title: About Nacho's Painting Contractors
text: Nacho's Painting got its start in 2008 when three brothers, Pedro, Evencio and Ignacio Moreno, joined to start their first company. Like most start-ups, the funds were low and the dreams were big. But they were full of passion and determination, so they started out anyway. The intentions were pretty simple: to work for themselves and to get more out of life for them and their families.

As simple as the business plan was, with decades of experience they knew that the painting would be the easy part. But they still needed to land their first job. None of them had ever owned a company, nor had they been in the position to solicit work. After hitting the pavement and visiting every old contact they had, they landed their first contract for a hotel building. One became two. Things were finally rolling.
Ignacio Moreno will meet with you, your architect and/or your interior designer to prepare an estimate and ensure that all aspects of your project are fully understood.
